hook.name: CaptainHookV2
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token launches on Robinhood Chain. Creators configure immutable trading rules at launch: allowlist phase, anti-snipe window, dynamic impact-based fee, max transaction limits, wallet cap, sandwich guard, buy/sell taxes, exit clock, auto burn, and buyback & burn. The hook collects all fees and taxes in ETH via swap return deltas. Only the factory may add liquidity, which is permanently locked. Exact-input swaps only.
